text: Webster Parish is heading into August with 90 homes on the market and a median price of $191,000 — homes are moving around the 56-day mark, which is a reasonable pace for buyers and sellers both. Last week brought eight new listings and eleven price adjustments into Webster, so buyers have real choices and sellers are paying attention to what the market is telling them. Five homes left the market last week across Webster and Claiborne, ranging from a modest cottage in Doyline to a nicer place over in Athens — steady, quiet absorption. Claiborne Parish is moving at a slower pace with 32 listings active, a $212,450 median, and about 100 days on market on average, so there's genuine room to negotiate if you're looking in that direction. Either way, if you've been on the fence about buying or selling in these parishes, August is shaping up to be a month worth taking seriously.
